style: Cinematic matte painting, painterly brushwork with near-photographic lighting, volumetric haze, dramatic, high contrast, vivid. No text, no lettering, no watermark.

shots.prompt: Epic wide landscape composite of impossible unbuilt megastructures at golden hour: a needle skyscraper one mile tall piercing the clouds on the left, a colossal glass pyramid in a bay on the right, a giant dam across a strait in the distance, tiny cars and people for scale, dramatic sky, empty space in the upper middle for a headline.
